about: A record with a bytes field bounded by the sce:max-size its schema declares, eight bytes: built whole from its <sce:set>s, written a field at a time from a literal and from a bytes variable, compared with === and !==, measured by len, copied into a list of records and read back by a loop. A bytes value is its byte-exact Latin-1 text wherever it is written, so the printable ASCII of these steps reads as itself. A value past the bound fails as any assignment does: nothing is written, error.execution is raised (`errors` counts it) and the block ends, so the record is left as it was. Expected values are derived from the byte counts, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: built whole from its <sce:set>s
the bytes of the field are the literal's: a match
the length of two bytes
eight bytes fit a bound of eight
eight bytes are not `ab`: a miss, and !== is true
the length of eight bytes
nine bytes do not fit: the record is left as it was and error.execution is raised
back to two bytes
two bytes of the same length as `ab`, and not its bytes
the same length is not the same bytes: a miss, and === is false
back to `ab`
a bytes variable of five bytes fits the field
the variable holds sixteen bytes, which its own bound admits
sixteen bytes do not fit a field of eight: the field is left as it was
a field of five bytes into a variable of sixteen
a list of records holds a copy of the record as it stands, with its bytes
the record changes and the copy in the list does not
a second copy
the loop reads the byte field of each record it walks: the variable is the last one's
the third copy fills the list
a full list takes no more: the list is left as it was and error.execution is raised
the byte field of the record at an index is read as a loop's is: the first, five bytes, into a variable of sixteen
a guard comparing the first with `ab` is false for `hello`, and raises nothing
the length of the last, by an index computed from the length of the list
the first record whole into `last`: its number and its five bytes, which the field of eight holds
the last record whole, by an index computed from the length: two bytes again
emptied
one record again, whose bytes are `ab`
the guard holds for the first now
the first, two bytes, into the variable
emptied again
the list has no record at index 0: nothing is read, the variable is left as it was and error.execution is raised
the guard cannot be evaluated: it is false, and error.execution says so
no last record to measure: the length is left as it was and error.execution is raised
no record at index 0 to take whole: `last` is left as it was, number and bytes, and error.execution is raised
nor a last one: len(frames) - 1 is an unsigned underflow
